# NCAAF Week 11 - Sat Nov 14

Edge factor ~0.58 applied. Sources: SportsLine model (CBS), Covers AI (Kalshi lines), Dimers, sharp-move and splits reports. Ole Miss at Oklahoma moved to Sunday; Utah at Arizona pushed to 10:30 PM ET (Friday FAA ground stop).

## Picks
- **Wake Forest +1.5 at SMU (-112), 0.75u (noon).** SportsLine covers "well over 60%" of sims; Covers AI Wake 34-27; Dimers a coin flip (Wake 48.3%). The line flipped from Wake -2.5 to SMU -1/-1.5 while QB Gio Lopez (lower body) was in doubt - he is now listed probable. SMU out: RB Link Rhodes, WR Carterrious Brown, DE Ira Singleton IV, S Tyren Polley Jr.; safeties Moses and Milliner-Jones questionable. Against: Wake missing two OL; SMU unbeaten at home. Raw ~59% -> 55.2% vs 52.8%.
- **Oregon -10.5 vs Michigan (-110), 0.5u (3:30).** SportsLine Oregon by 16 (covers well over 60%); Covers AI 27-14; ScoreGPT panel 25-13; Dimers on the number (81.2%). Michigan fired its OC after the Michigan State loss (OL coach calling plays), has reopened the QB job (Underwood/Carr) and has allowed 16 sacks behind five line combinations. Fading the side in QB turmoil with two models. Only at -10.5 (some books -11.5); small because the line already moved from -8.5.

## Leans (ranked)
1. Michigan/Oregon Over 38.5 - SportsLine well over 70%, Covers AI 41. Correlated with the Oregon bet, and Michigan's defense is elite; not stacking.
2. South Carolina -7 at Arkansas - SportsLine 31-20 (57%), Covers AI 31-21, Dimers on the number. At -7.5 it is the hook through 7; bet only at -7.
3. Northwestern/Ohio State Over 45.5 - SportsLine over, Covers AI 49. No cover % published.
4. Florida/Kentucky Under 52.5 - SportsLine 49 (58%) but Covers AI 55. Split.
5. Indiana -9.5 vs USC - Covers AI by 13; Dimers on the number; Indiana QB uncertainty, sharp money on the under. Pass.
6. Tennessee/Texas A&M - line has flipped around pick'em on 97% Tennessee money; Dimers 50/50. Pass.

picks.summary: SportsLine >60% and Covers AI (Wake by 7) agree; line moved on Lopez's injury and he is now probable; SMU short-handed.
SportsLine by 16 and Covers AI by 13; Michigan has an interim play-caller, an open QB job and a broken line.
